title: G3O Standardized Procurement Record
description: EXTRACTION INTERMEDIATE. One standardized record as pulled from a procurement repository. This is NOT the emitted artifact: per docs/procurement-extension-spec.md the pipeline emits (a) rows conforming to the 39-field G3O output contract v2.0 at grain (institution x activity x source), plus (b) one procurement_extension row per primary row joined 1:1 on record_id, plus (c) institution_link rows. This schema is the staging shape those three are built from. Updated 2026-08-03 per spec section 7; 2026-08-04 for PI rulings Q1a/D1 (activity_type), D2/D3 (adoption_stage).

record_id.description: Pipeline-generated stable id, e.g. sha1(source_id + '|' + native_id). Dedup/upsert key, and the join key to procurement_extension and institution_link.

native_id.description: The tender/award id as issued by the source.

ocds_ocid.description: OCDS open contracting id, when the source is OCDS.

notice_type.description: Aligned with tracker coverage_type. Drives adoption_stage (D13) per spec section 6.

buyer_url.description: Buyer's own web address as stated by the source. Added per spec section 4.4 — highest-value institution-matching signal (matcher tier 1).

buyer_national_id.description: Buyer's national registry identifier where the source carries one. Added per spec section 4.4 — matcher tier 2.

buyer_email_domain.description: Derived from a stated buyer contact address. Fallback matching signal (spec section 4.4).

supplier_name.description: Populated for awards. Maps to contract vendor (D17); see spec section 4.2 on resellers.

url.description: Link to the notice. Never fabricate or alter.

genai_relevant.description: PROVISIONAL candidate-classifier verdict. True means proposed relevant; it is not final contract field C8 until human review confirms it. Contract no/confirms_absence is created at searched-source level, not from one rejected candidate.

genai_relevance_score.description: Confidence/similarity score from the classifier backend.

genai_category.description: The G3O output contract v2.0 activity_type (D12) enum, closed 2026-08-03 per spec section 7.2. Members copied verbatim from docs/reference/output_contract_v2.0.SNAPSHOT.md; mirrored in pipeline/core/contract.ACTIVITY_TYPE. No procurement-specific taxonomy exists and none may be invented (PI ruling 2026-07-28).
genai_category.$comment: Assigned by pipeline/core/coding.activity_type_for() under PI ruling Q1a (2026-08-04): the contract's section 4.2 'Typical evidence' column names procurement records for pilot_experiment, internal_operational and public_facing_service, so those may be applied directly. null at the STAGING layer means the record was relevant but could not be typed - ruling D1 says such a record is REPORTED, NOT CODED, because 'unknown' is the ruled answer yet is not a legal member until contract v2.2 lands. Contract-conformant output must never carry null: it takes a member, or '_NA_' when genai_evidence is not confirms_activity.

genai_evidence.description: Matched terms / verbatim text snippet supporting the disposition (transparency trail). Feeds contract source_snippet (column 37), which caps at 300 chars.

genai_evidence_type.description: Contract genai_evidence (column 36) for THIS source. Members copied verbatim from the contract snapshot; mirrored in pipeline/core/contract.GENAI_EVIDENCE. Assessable per source - contract Edge Case A codes a page with no GenAI mention as confirms_absence on that row. Distinct from has_genai_activity (column 8), which is institution-level and is NOT derivable from one record.
genai_evidence_type.$comment: background_only is never emitted by the current classifier: it means a source gives general context without documenting activity at the institution, and this channel reads only procurement records for a named buyer. Left to the primary-row builder.

adoption_stage.description: Contract adoption_stage (column 13). Members copied verbatim from the contract snapshot; mirrored in pipeline/core/contract.ADOPTION_STAGE. Set by pipeline/core/coding.adoption_stage_for(): an award is announced dated by the contract/award date (spec section 6.1), a tender is proposed (PI ruling D2/D3, 2026-08-04, which overrides the recommended default in spec section 6.2) — but ONLY when genai_evidence_type is confirms_activity (bug fix 2026-08-08; the ruling text itself ties proposed to confirms_activity, section 6 check 2). null when the source cannot say whether the record is a tender or an award, OR when the evidence does not confirm activity (confirms_absence / ambiguous / background_only) — the contract-output mapper turns that null into _NA_, not this schema.
adoption_stage.$comment: 'production' is unreachable from procurement evidence by construction: a purchase is not a deployment (spec section 6.1). Contract Edge Case B shows production only because that notice evidences a completed licence deployment.

review_flags.description: Operational triggers that must survive staging so accepted human-review rules are not reduced to an in-memory count.

review_status.description: Operational staging status only. A full reviewer decision table is still pending.

fetched_at.description: When the raw record was retrieved. Feeds source_access_date (E32), date only.

classifier_version.description: Version/id of the classifier backend used (NLP model id or LLM model id + params).

raw_payload_ref.description: Path/key into data_cache for the raw payload this record derives from.
